value.rationale: The primary literature poses a natural existence problem for periodic points of normalized affine rotation maps and establishes only an unspecified neighbourhood near a half-turn. Determining the entire exact two-cycle tongue, its quadratic weak-translation width, and the sink/source/neutral transition closes a meaningful model-specific gap and permits sharp bifurcation analysis without asserting higher-period results.
